scope: Tk 9.0.4 official sources selected by the pinned python-build-standalone release and its Mac Aqua build recipe; not whole-product or final-binary absence certification

archive.note: This commit-addressed official Git source archive is independent source evidence. It is not the SourceForge archive with expected SHA256 d7a146d2917eb8b5cc95276dbf0e3d03c7464d2b19c1675357857c989301dbb4 and does not replace that approved dependency asset.

buildRecipe.x11LinkFlagsScope: The X11/xcb/Xau link flags are added only when PYBUILD_PLATFORM is not macos*. The source patch of tk.pc.in is also in the non-Mac branch.

assessment.sourceFindings: All 958 official Git blobs were byte-matched before the source scan. No TekColor, TekHVC or Xcms pattern was found in any matched blob. This is stronger than path-name or shared-library-load absence alone.
assessment.conditionalDuty: The retained Tektronix clause about applications displaying TekHVC coordinates is conditional. The audited official Tk source and pinned Mac --without-x recipe provide scoped evidence against incorporation of that specific Xcms/TekColor implementation through this Tk route.
assessment.retention: Keep complete X11/Xau/xcb notices. Do not infer that their text can be deleted merely because this source route does not incorporate TekColor/Xcms.
